name: iw5
title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 3 (IW5, 64-bit rebuild)
note: Addresses from the shipped iw5sp.exe (2026-09-07 build, x64; .text is plain code, only the SteamStub .bind section is packed), flattened (file offset == RVA). Stream primitives found by disassembly, the rest read from the neighbours of Load_Stream: MW2's stream code, one block more.
rva_note: As MW2 (profiles/iw4). resolve / resolve_deref read the low dword only: v - 1 = block << 28 | offset (shr 0x1c on a 32-bit value). 0x8f430 is `mov ecx, 3; jmp alloc`.

asset_dispatch.note: Load_XAsset(flag): Load_Stream(flag, varXAsset, 16), varXAssetHeader = varXAsset + 8, then Load_XAssetHeader (0x9bd20) compares the type and calls the type's Ptr loader with its var set

release.note: 79 of the 94 zones are under release-check's 256 MB measure cap

zone_header.note: the stream starts at size; the 0x20-byte XAssetList before it (after the 0x2c-byte XFile: 9 blocks)

zone_load.note: the tail of DB_LoadXFile (0x8eba0): the 0x2c-byte XFile, the 0x20-byte XAssetList raw-read into a static (varXAssetList = it); under push(3) the script strings (0x965d0); under push(3) the asset array allocated (0x8f430), Load_Stream-ed, and each entry dispatched with varXAsset = &list[i]
